FIGHTER          MAGE          CLERIC          THIEF
Barbarian        Wizard        Priest          Rogue
Cavalier         Monk          Druid           Bard
Valkyrie         Ranger        Shaman          Knave

 [1045] paladin - a fighter class that specializes in healing others
 [1046] rangers - a mage class that receives a wide variety of magic
 [1047] psionic - a mage class that receives unique magic which targets other Adventurers
 [1048] monk - mages who have abandoned greater goals and seek personal glory
 [1049] shaman - a cleric class which focuses on healing and defensive magic
 [1050] cavalier - a fighter class which relies on its mounts
 [1051] druid - a cleric class which uses nature magic to perform a variety of tasks
 [1052] valkyrie - a fighter class which focuses on defense and not dying
 [1053] bard - a thief class which uses music to provide buffs to their formation
 [1054] rogue - a thief class which specializes in being unseen and mobile
 [1106] witch - a cleric class specializing in debuffs, but lacking in healing
 [2035] knave - a thief class which relies equally on brute force and underhanded trickery

===== 2026-01-01 00:00:00 | cmd=help dwarf | room=10421
[1032 ] DWARF
NAME
dwarf - a hardy playable race from the underground

SYNOPSIS
Lorem Ipsum

DESCRIPTION
Dwarves are short, stocky demi-humans, known for their foul tempers.  They
often prefer building their cities underground, and enjoy working with the
earth.  Dwarves are excellent miners, and possess more detailed knowledge on
gems and metalsmithing than any other race.  They can easily be identified
by the long beards that both males and females alike wear proudly.  

While Dwarves are not as smart as some of the other races, they are usually
wiser due to their long lifespans.  Their great physical strength and
stamina makes them resistant to the effects of poison, disease, and magic,
and centuries of working underground have given the Dwarves a keen ability
to see in the dark.  While they are excellent fighters, Dwarves are not very
dexterous and often distrust the use of magical spells.  

Dwarves' racial ability is to deal 10% more damage with bashing weapons. 
Dwarves dig more effectively than others, possessing a baseline of +25 dig. 
While in Underground wildernesses, Dwarves can see 2 distance further.  In
addition, dwarves' hardiness not only makes them resistant to disease and
poison, but reduces 10% of critical hits taken to non-critical.  


Class availability:
     Mage: Wizard      Psionic     Monk        Ranger      
  Warrior: Barbarian   Paladin     Cavalier    
   Cleric: Priest      Druid       
    Thief: Rogue       Bard        

Maximum racial stats (before class bonuses):      (average is 17)
  Strength:           18     Vitality:       19
  Knowledge:          16     Luck:           16
  Wisdom:             16     Courage:        20
  Agility:            16     Sanity:         18
  Personality:        16

Maximum racial vital attributes:                 (average is 2000)
  Hit Points:     2250   Spell Points:    1700   Stamina:    2250

Racial skills:
  enhanced damage - learn specific moves in order to maximize damage inflicted on a target.
  mace - a short-ranged weapon used to bash
  flail - a long bashing weapon
  spiderrider - summons a cluster of arachnids to carry the caster straight into the Underground
  peek - the ability to discern what exact items a creature is carrying
  orbiting mass - send a mass of stone into orbit around someone, protecting them

Passive racial skills:
  infravision - provides faster adaptation to seeing in darkness
  hardy - tough bodies can resist disease and poison
  conductive - some beings are subtly vulnerable to lightning damage


SEE ALSO:
 [2378] spiderrider - summons a cluster of arachnids to carry the caster straight into the Underground
 [1066] races - the many playable races of Alyria
 [1365] mace - a short-ranged weapon used to bash
 [1160] dig - dig up ground at a location to look for a buried item or door
